decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this original consent i.e 10th March 2025.
Reason: In order to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended by Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: [PL1/SM/3448 � 03_A, PL1/SM/3448 � 04_C, PL1/SM/3448 � 05_C, PL1/SM/3448 � 06_C, PL1/SM/3448 � 07_C received 04 June 2025].
Reason: In order to ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.

Condition : 3 - The windows formed in the [western] elevation shall be obscure-glazed and non-opening below 1.7 metres above internal floor level. The windows shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than in accordance with the requirements of this condition. 
Reason: In order to protect neighbours' privacy

Condition : 4 - No additional windows or openings shall be formed in the [eastern and western] elevation of the development hereby permitted.
Reason: In order to protect neighbours' privacy.

Condition : 5 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.
Reason: In order to safeguard the appearance of the area.
description: Variation of condition 2 approved plans for alterations to size and style of the rear window to the rear roof dormer, and the installation of one roof light to the rear roof dormer, of planning permission P/2025/0097 approved 10/03/2025 for Erection of a part first floor rear extension, rear and side roof extension to the house.
